descriptions.w3d_d27e_wave_peaks_801e39bc: Builds the peak overview of a 16-bit sound buffer: copies the samples, smooths them with a running average over rate/smooth samples, reduces them to count = samples/rate*pointRate points by taking the absolute peak of each block, applies a one-pole smear (gain 0.2, decay 0.8), normalises to the highest peak and stores each point as a byte 0..255. Returns E_FAIL without data. Field names are inferred from the arithmetic.
